review.headline: I Love These--Super Comfortable
review.reviewBody: I can't tell you how comfortable these shoes are--or actually, I CAN tell you.  I've worn earlier HOVR versions, they are my go-to shoes, and I've now worn these the past three days so I could judge.  These shoes cradle your feet snugly, but not too snugly, more like a swaddle, and the bottom cushioning is ample, springy but yet firm enough.  I wear 9s in UA, 8-1/2s for some other brands.  I got 9s for these, based on other reviewers, and while they might be just a smidge narrow in the toebox, it loosened up by the second try.  The laces feel good, tie well and are not too long once tied.  The graphite/red/orange looks stylish.  For those of you, like me, who have liked earlier versions of HOVR, these will wrap around your feet a bit more, in a comfortable way, and the soles will feel terrific.  I've tried shoes of several other popular brands other people swear by, and they do NOT feel good on my feet.  These do.  And that's what counts, over the long run.  I'm sold.

review.headline: Love the shoe
review.reviewBody: I just keep hitting 100's with Under Armour's new products! This shoe is very comfortable and provides the stability I need. The first is a little snug...usually wear 8.5 but the 9 is just fine.

review.headline: LEGIT
review.reviewBody: Very impressed by these kicks. Springy, and really nice cushioning/fit. Fit my narrow foot like a glove and is a joy to run and workout in. Highly recommend. That orange is attractive too.

review.headline: Great Looking / Great Performing Shoe
review.reviewBody:
I wore them for the 1st time on 29 Aug 2021, when I ran the Head for the Cure 5K.
This shoe felt great, very comfortable, and I ran a personal best average of 8 min, 02 seconds per mile. I would buy these again!
